machines.notes: Portable large-format router (packs into a van), cuts 2500 x 1250 mm sheets edge to edge, material up to 152 mm thick. YetiPilot adjusts feed from spindle load. Laser X/Y datum. Accuracy +/-0.5 mm. CAM: VCarve or Fusion 360.
